The mortar basin, the trowel, and the top course of the brick wall remain within the camera wearer's arm's reach throughout the sequence, whereas the loose bricks and rocks on the ground below are out of reach and the mortar basin is partly cropped by the lower-left frame border in frames 1, 3, and 5.
